Self.Wiki: Sound region (the game's CSMsbPointSoundRegion). Overrides the map's sound settings (MapDefaultInfoParam) while the listener is inside it. The game picks the active region separately for each field, and a field only counts when it is not -1 and the region's shape is a Box. Regions with a Water Type also define a water sound.

ReverbType.Wiki: The reverb type used inside the region. It replaces MapDefaultInfoParam ReverbDefaultType and the automatic reverb selection. -1: no override. Retail uses 3-8.

WaterType.Wiki: The kind of water this region's water sound represents. Regions with the same Water Type and Water ID form one water sound, which the game names e.g. 海_ID:0.

WaterID.Wiki: The ID of the water sound group within its Water Type. Only used when Water Type is not None. Retail uses 0 and 1.

OutdoorIndoorType.Wiki: Overrides the outdoor/indoor sound mode, like Collision Outdoor/Indoor Type: 0 outdoor, 1 half indoor, 2 indoor (Wwise OutdoorIndoor states). -1: no override.

WwiseEnvPlaceTypeID.Wiki: The Wwise environment place type used inside the region. -1: no override.

EnvPlaceInfo.Wiki: Replaces MapDefaultInfoParam EnvPlaceInfo inside the region. The game looks the value up in WwiseValueToStrParam_EnvPlaceType and sets the Wwise state from its string. -1: no override.

CommonPlaceType.Wiki: The common place type used inside the region (-1 = none). The sound update switches to it after a 2-second delay.

DisableAutoCliffWind.Wiki: Replaces MapDefaultInfoParam isDisableAutoCliffWind inside the region: 1 disables the automatic cliff wind sound, 0 enables it. -1: no override. Only read in DLC (m61) maps; retail uses 1 on ten regions.
